outputs.explanation: Spatial transcriptomic cluster image, not a quantitative plot.
H&E histology images with annotations, not a quantitative plot.
Histology and spatial gene expression images, not a quantitative bar/summary plot.
GSEA enrichment plots are line plots, which are exempt from requiring overlaid individual data points.

Bar graph shows log2 fold-change values per gene from a differential expression (Wilcoxon rank-sum) test comparing Tmprss11b-high vs -low spatial transcriptomic regions. Each bar represents a single computed statistic (fold change with associated p-value) derived from a bulk comparison across many spots, not an average of a small number of discrete replicates, so there are no distinct 'individual data points' to overlay.
